recent_jobs.startCommand: node --input-type=module -e "import {Pool} from \"pg\"; import {S3Client,ListObjectsV2Command} from \"@aws-sdk/client-s3\"; const need=[\"DATABASE_URL\",\"R2_ENDPOINT\",\"R2_BUCKET\",\"R2_ACCESS_KEY_ID\",\"R2_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY\"]; const slots=Object.fromEntries(need.map(k=>[k,Boolean(process.env[k])])); if(Object.values(slots).some(v=>!v)) throw Error(\"managed slot absent\"); const pool=new Pool({connectionString:process.env.DATABASE_URL}); const q=await pool.query(\"SELECT current_database() db, (SELECT count(*)::int FROM schema_migrations) migrations, (SELECT max(version) FROM schema_migrations) latest, (SELECT count(*)::int FROM products) products\"); const s3=new S3Client({endpoint:process.env.R2_ENDPOINT,region:process.env.R2_REGION||\"auto\",credentials:{accessKeyId:process.env.R2_ACCESS_KEY_ID,secretAccessKey:process.env.R2_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY},forcePathStyle:true}); const page=await s3.send(new ListObjectsV2Command({Bucket:process.env.R2_BUCKET,MaxKeys:1})); console.log(JSON.stringify({schema:\"lane-a-managed-readback/v1\",exact_sha:process.env.RENDER_GIT_COMMIT||null,db:{connected:true,name:q.rows[0].db,migrations:q.rows[0].migrations,latest:q.rows[0].latest,products:q.rows[0].products},r2:{connected:true,key_count_at_most_one:(page.Contents||[]).length,bucket_name_redacted:true},slots_present:slots,mutation:false})); await pool.end();"

node -e 'const {Queue}=require("bullmq"); (async()=>{const c={connection:{url:process.env.REDIS_URL,maxRetriesPerRequest:null}}; for(const name of [process.env.REDIS_QUEUE_NAME||"racun-jobs","racun-promo-jobs"]){const q=new Queue(name,c); console.log("CANONICAL_QUEUE_SUSTAINED "+JSON.stringify({name,counts:await q.getJobCounts("wait","active","delayed","prioritized","failed"),paused:await q.isPaused()})); await q.close()} process.exit(0)})().catch(e=>{console.error("CANONICAL_QUEUE_ERROR "+e.message);process.exit(1)})'
